solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id, weight_kg AS second_weight
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id,
         weight_kg,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY weight_kg DESC) AS rnk
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, weight_kg
    FROM shipments
    WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  ) AS distinct_weights
) AS ranked
WHERE rnk = 2
ORDER BY customer_id;

rules.howSolved: DENSE_RANK over each customer's distinct weights, descending, and keep rank 2 so the second-highest distinct value is returned.
SELECT DISTINCT on (customer_id, weight_kg) collapses shared weights before ranking.
Filtering to rank 2 drops any customer with only one distinct weight because they have no rank 2 row.
WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL in the distinct subquery removes shipments without a weight before ranking.

notes: Ran without error on sample, nulls, ties and boundary. No guesses needed beyond the explicit wording.
